title: Proving it is you
concept: Signing in to GitHub, explained (automatic in the game)

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: In reality, GitHub will ask you to sign in via your browser so it knows who you are. In this game, you're already signed in!

questions.prompt: Do you need to configure SSH keys or tokens in this game?

recap: On a real computer, GitHub uses your browser to sign you in.
